parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the response.

Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of your Cloud Firewall.

>  For more information about Cloud Firewall supported regions, see [Supported regions](~~195657~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-cfw-risk-level-summary --lang zh --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type EcsEIP --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw DescribeCfwRiskLevelSummary --region cn-hangzhou --Lang zh --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType EcsEIP
